preconditions.description: The input S must be a string.
The string S must contain at least one character.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(min(len(S), len(suffix)) for suffix in [S[i:] for i in range(len(S))] if all(S[k] == suffix[k] for k in range(min(len(S), len(suffix))) else True))
postconditions.description: The return value is the sum of the lengths of the longest common prefixes between S and each of its suffixes.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(next((k for k in range(min(len(S), len(S[i:])) if S[:k] != S[i:i+k] else None), min(len(S), len(S[i:]))) for i in range(len(S)))
postconditions.description: For each suffix starting at index i, the similarity is the length of the longest prefix common to S and that suffix, and the result is the sum of these similarities.
